description: Single-file flowchart editor on SVG: draggable node palette (start/process/decision/io/end), port-to-port bezier edges with delete, drag to move, pan/zoom, undo/redo, selection, JSON save/load, export SVG, validation of dangling nodes.

criteria: flowdraw_model_01.html is one self-contained flowchart editor (no libraries): a palette of at least five node shapes (terminal, process, decision, I/O, database or note), nodes that drag on a grid with snapping, edges drawn as bezier curves from output port to input port with arrowheads that stay attached while nodes move, edge selection and deletion, marquee or multi-selection, delete/copy/paste, undo and redo of at least node/edge add-move-delete operations, pan and zoom with mouse wheel, decision nodes requiring one incoming and two outgoing edges in the validation report, JSON export/import, and SVG export of the diagram. No disconnected invisible state.
